title: CB-00 Invariant Mapping Correction
reason: Post-merge audit found that SW0-06/SW0-07 machine-readable invariant IDs had drifted from the authoritative CB-00 invariant catalogue.

corrections.authoritative: Physical quantity creation/destruction requires traceable event, transformation or measured variance.
corrections.reason: negative quantity/over-allocation proofs are insufficient for the full invariant
lot receipt alone does not prove transformation provenance

corrections.authoritative: Unavailable/unsafe/held quantity cannot become available merely through allocation or projection.
Ownership, possession, custody, control, allocation and encumbrance remain distinguishable.
Positive expected return cannot justify an action that violates hard liquidity/solvency constraints.
Security interests/restrictions remain visible to any disposition/availability decision.
No unauthorized double pledge or double representation of unencumbered collateral capacity.
Possession, custody, title, risk, acceptance, settlement and discharge are orthogonal.
Only actually conforming performed quantity is discharged.

doctrine: Correction is additive. Historical SW0-06/SW0-07 release evidence is not deleted; this record supersedes its invariant-ID interpretation.
next: SW0-08 may proceed only against authoritative invariant text, not prior numeric assumptions.
